mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An abrupt rise in the CPI inflation index above 5% in a monthly period triggers investor concerns about overheating economies, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative during the trigger period, or the inflation spike is followed by a rapid reversal without sustained negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained outperformance of demand-side GDP (GDPC1) over supply-side production (INDPRO) by at least 2% monthly signals excess demand, driving up equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 leads INDPRO by >2% in a month
failure_condition: The GDPC1-INDPRO ratio does not exceed 2% in any month during the trigger period, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive relative to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle characterized by persistent FEDFUNDS rates below 1.5% and rising GDPC1, investors anticipate lower future interest rates, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS <1.5% and GDPC1 increasing for two consecutive months
failure_condition: The FEDFUNDS rate does not remain below 1.5% for two consecutive months with rising GDPC1, or 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 3.0% signals a robust labor market, reducing risk premium pressures and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The UNRATE decline does not correlate with statistically significant positive 5-day forward returns (p > 0.05 in t-test), or the rate remains above 3.0% during the period.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged contraction in the INDPRO index below 95 for two consecutive months indicates weakening manufacturing activity, leading to reduced corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The INDPRO contraction does not precede a significant negative 60-day return (p < 0.05 in t-test), or the index recovers above 95 within the next month without sustained negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in both unemployment rate below 2.8% and employment (PAYEMS) above 50,000 suggest a robust labor market, reducing risk aversion and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE <2.8% and PAYEMS >50,000 in a month
failure_condition: The UNRATE-PAYEMS combination does not meet the trigger threshold in any month during the period, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive relative to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of historically low unemployment (UNRATE <2.5%) and elevated employment (PAYEMS >150,000), investors anticipate sustained economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The UNRATE-PAYEMS combination does not meet the trigger threshold in any month during the period, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive relative to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
